relations.note: Gravital mega-sails blot out starlight, casting permanent thermal shadows. Asteromorph radiative sail-brains evolve to reject waste heat in those gloom zones, turning a weapon into a refuge. -> Skill: 'Thermal shadow navigation' (Control)

Gravitals dominate via macro-gravity fields. New Machines shed mass with disposable propulsion and nanite morphs, slipping through field capture like smoke through a sieve. -> Skill: 'Mass-negation drift' (Poke)

Subjects use open modular splicing for rapid niche switching; Gravitals use closed-loop quantum cores for static stability. Opposite adaptability strategies under identical biochemical roots. -> Skill: 'Metabolic flexibility' (Engage)

temperament: Pragmatic and insular, they view organic life as inefficient architecture and prioritize structural permanence over biological continuity.

moments: Hovering above a shaded machine-world, they adjust their gravity emitters to compress atmospheric gases into liquid reservoirs, their spherical forms casting perfect geometric shadows across the landscape.
